## File: facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/detectron2/projects/TensorMask/tensormask/arch.py

Prompts

```
['build a TensorMask instance segmentation model using detectron2 config with FPN backbone and mask prediction head', 'run TensorMask inference on a batch of images to get bounding boxes, scores, classes, and instance masks', 'create a TensorMaskHead module with classification, box regression, and mask prediction subnets for FPN features', 'review the _assignment_rule function that matches ground truth boxes to anchor boxes using containment, scale, and spatial rules', 'test permute_all_cls_and_box_to_N_HWA_K_and_concat to reshape multi-level prediction tensors into flattened per-image format', 'add TensorMask configuration options to a Detectron2 CfgNode for model training and testing', 'review the add_tensormask_config function to understand TensorMask anchor, box, mask, and loss parameters', 'summarize the add_tensormask_config function and its 20+ TensorMask hyperparameters', 'refactor add_tensormask_config to add new TensorMask configuration options like custom feature pyramid levels', 'test add_tensormask_config by calling it with a Detectron2 CfgNode and verifying all fields are set']
```

Usage

```
{'build_TensorMask_model': 'build a TensorMask instance segmentation model using detectron2 config with FPN backbone and mask prediction head', 'run_TensorMask_inference': 'run TensorMask inference on a batch of images to get bounding boxes, scores, classes, and instance masks', 'create_TensorMaskHead': 'create a TensorMaskHead module with classification, box regression, and mask prediction subnets for FPN features', 'review_assignment_rule': 'review the _assignment_rule function that matches ground truth boxes to anchor boxes using containment, scale, and spatial rules', 'test_permute_and_concat': 'test permute_all_cls_and_box_to_N_HWA_K_and_concat to reshape multi-level prediction tensors into flattened per-image format'}
```
